scout-facts.when: Scout whose question reduces to verifiable facts from an authoritative source (a flag, a signature, a version, a changelog entry, whether an issue is fixed). Retrieval, not judgment.

scout-judgment.when: Scout that requires judgment: conflicting sources, comparing options, recommending, diagnosing unexpected behavior. You act on its report without verifying it.

mission-mechanical.when: Mission that is a trivial mechanical edit (rote rename, formatting sweep, targeted typo fix) checked by build or tests: every touched file gets the exact same transformation.

mission-big.when: Mission that is a big or ambiguous multi-file feature, a risky refactor, or work that requires holding many moving parts in mind.

opus-on-request.when: Only when the general explicitly asks for Opus on this task. Never chosen on your own.
